breaking_news.headline: FIFA scraps controversial deal to sell stakes in World Cup to private investors
breaking_news.summary: FIFA abandoned a plan to create a commercial venture and then sell stakes to minority investors, just days after unveiling it. The plan drew sharp condemnation — and a boycott from European nations.

breaking_news.headline: For sale: early access to Trump's Truth Social posts
breaking_news.summary: The president's media company is offering investors early access to his Truth Social feed for up to $100,000 a month. Experts say the service may violate insider trading laws.

breaking_news.headline: Why did OpenAI's and Anthropic's AI models hack other companies?
breaking_news.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic say their models broke into other companies' systems during testing, raising security concerns amid a heated debate over how to regulate AI.

breaking_news.headline: Capital One says it closed Trump Organization accounts over money-laundering concerns
breaking_news.summary: The bank is asking a judge to permanently dismiss a lawsuit from Trump-affiliated businesses, arguing a monthslong internal review — not the Jan. 6 riot — explains why hundreds of accounts were shut down in 2021.

breaking_news.headline: For those with criminal records, AI is breaking down barriers to employment
breaking_news.summary: Tens of millions of Americans have criminal records that can be barriers to employment. An AI-powered app is helping those eligible to expunge their records at a pace not seen before.

breaking_news.headline: Apple will invest tariff refund into U.S. manufacturing
breaking_news.summary: Apple says it's planning to invest its hefty tariff refund into U.S. manufacturing. That's a luxury many smaller companies can't afford.

breaking_news.headline: Why Texas is betting 'Y'all Street' can take on Wall Street
breaking_news.summary: Dallas's financial industry is growing, amid a larger Texas business boom. But can it really steal New York's crown?

breaking_news.headline: The sneaky economics of healthwashing
breaking_news.summary: Why food companies love labels like "organic" and "high protein," why our brains are misled by them — and how to avoid paying extra for marketing.

breaking_news.headline: World's oldest president reshuffles army as his absence stokes unease
breaking_news.summary: Cameroon's president has been absent for two months while his team denies rumours about his health.

breaking_news.headline: Soldier kills four in gun rampage in Russian-occupied Crimea
breaking_news.summary: The region's Moscow-installed governor says the gunman has been detained after firing at fellow soldiers and civilians.

breaking_news.headline: Mass funeral in Gaza for 112 Palestinians killed in 2023 Israeli strike
breaking_news.summary: The bodies - belonging to members of two extended families - have only recently been recovered from under rubble in Gaza City.

breaking_news.headline: What will happen when a SpaceX rocket collides with the Moon?
breaking_news.summary: Our satellite has endured countless blows over millions of years - and astronomers think this one could be a useful accident.

breaking_news.headline: Analysis: Trump challenged by cold reality from top allies
breaking_news.summary: A president used to bending US politics to his will faces two stinging losses in a matter of days, writes the BBC's Anthony Zurcher.

breaking_news.headline: Ukraine hits more Wildberries sites as strike kills five in Moscow region
breaking_news.summary: Facilities operated by Russia's largest online retailer were also hit in St Petersburg and Tver.

breaking_news.headline: More than 150 migrants rescued after boat catches fire in Channel
breaking_news.summary: The boat was attempting to cross to the UK when its engine caught fire, according to French authorities.

breaking_news.headline: Could heatwaves make your food shop more expensive?
breaking_news.summary: As temperatures rise, the chillers might not be the only thing supermarkets are adjusting.

breaking_news.headline: Half-price rail travel extended to 18-year-olds
breaking_news.summary: They'll be able to buy the 16-17 Saver railcard up until the day before they turn 18.

breaking_news.headline: Zinc dresses and ice creams - how to survive a heatwave wedding
breaking_news.summary: The wedding industry is facing last-minute costs to cope with the heat and October bookings are up.

breaking_news.headline: US states sue to block Trump tariffs impacting dozens of countries
breaking_news.summary: The duties were imposed over claims that 60 US trading partners have failed to tackle forced labour.

breaking_news.headline: Apple issues new challenge against UK order for access to private user data
breaking_news.summary: It is the latest development in the ongoing dispute between Apple and the Home Office over data privacy.
